method: Exact rational cyclic polynomial and tensor-Bernstein initialization, coordinate degree16. Exact rational degree-elevated Gram polynomial G. Outward binary64 dyadic de Casteljau subdivision. Accept H<0 or H+lambda*G<0 for exactly nonnegative dyadic lambda, which implies H<0 wherever G>=0. Exclude only strictly Gram-negative boxes or boxes strictly outside sorted chamber. Exact permutation symmetry extends to full cube. No samples used for acceptance.
